project_title: Dillard's Social Manager - Field-Tech Command Center

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Mobile-first command center for field technicians on Android phones/tablets outdoors. High contrast, large touch targets (minimum 48px height), clean cards with solid 1px borders, clear visual status hierarchy.

components_and_features.navigation: Bottom tab bar navigation (Dashboard, Composer, Inbox, Leads, More) with smooth tab switching and high-contrast active icons.
components_and_features.dashboard_overview: Connection status pill, quick stat bento cards (Pending Approvals, Unread Inbox, Leads, Drafts), NOVA AI Copilot quick launcher.
components_and_features.composer: Guided post type selector (Before/After, Job Showcase, Maintenance Tip, Emergency Repair), notes + image attachment uploader, AI prompt builder generating 3 distinct tone variations (Professional, Local Friendly, Urgent Service).
components_and_features.approval_queue: Owner approval workflow with clear status badges (Pending Approval, AI Warning Flagged, Approved, Published, Rejected). Diff preview and edit capabilities.
components_and_features.content_calendar: Interactive calendar view (Month, Week, List) showing scheduled posts with channel tag, status, and publish time.
components_and_features.facebook_inbox: Tabs for Comments, Mentions, and Messenger. AI sentiment classification (Lead / Customer Service / General) and suggested AI quick replies.
components_and_features.leads_kanban_board: Kanban columns (New, Contacted, Estimate Sent, Job Scheduled, Completed, Closed). Quick phone call / SMS / Messenger response triggers.
components_and_features.media_library: Tagged photo gallery with alt text editor, privacy warnings for customer faces/license plates, and one-tap post composer seed.
components_and_features.business_brain: Editable knowledge base for AI training: Services offered, Operating hours, Service radius, FAQs, Brand voice rules, Pricing estimates.
components_and_features.analytics_and_settings: Performance cards (Page Reach, Engagement Rate, Top Posts, Lead Conversions), Facebook Page token connection status, Team roles, Audit trail.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive components (Buttons, Inputs, Cards, Tab Items, Action Sheets, Modals, Sliders) have explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='composer-submit-btn', data-testid='approval-approve-button').

Maintain strict dark charcoal (#121316 / #1A1C20) background aesthetic with vibrant irrigation green (#22C55E) accents and solid card borders (#2E333D) to maximize readability under sunlight on Android devices.
Do not use generic social media designs or consumer app clones; this is a tactical B2B command center for irrigation repair business owners and field techs.
Ensure the owner approval safety check is visually prominent: posts generated by AI must require explicit approval before publishing.
All list views, kanban columns, and detail drawers should be scrollable and optimized for touch interactions.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use pure black #000000 or un-tinted grays. Tint neutrals with cool slate/charcoal tones.
Ensure touch targets are at least 48px in height/width for field usability.
Use distinct status badges with semantic colors (Green for Approved/Published, Amber for Pending Approval, Red for Rejected/Warning).
Include micro-feedback on press actions (scale animation or color shift).
All dynamic data should fallback gracefully to mock data when backend APIs are offline or disconnected.
